evidence_tag: independent reproduction (this repo) - E15, E16, E17, E18; N1 controlled estimator (partially run)
caption:
Figure 1 | Real-data evidence for the two-mode QPEP/Laplace layer. (a) ADD-S on the controlled two-mode cost
(median [95% bootstrap CI over frames]): LINEMOD eggbox/glue n=15, LMO sequence 000002 n=177 (96 eggbox + 81 glue). The hard
argmin is less accurate under occlusion (LINEMOD 3.74 mm vs LMO 9.42 mm) while the posterior mean is 13.94 vs 18.70 mm
(MC 18.38 mm); both datasets show the same hard→Laplace bias. The earlier 37-frame LMO subset gives 10.17/19.02 mm, consistent.
(b) Simulated i.i.d. Gaussian detector noise on the 15 LINEMOD frames (clean RANSAC subset fixed, never re-fit; per-frame mean over
10 seeds, median and 95% CI over the 15 frames). Up to 1 px there is no measurable change; between 2 and 5 px the hard argmin slides along
the flat valley (2.06°→20.49°, frames >10°: 7%→66%) while the already-biased Laplace mean changes by 0.95×. (c) Same-data
forward/local references on the bitwise-identical 15-frame correspondences: the five solver/initialisation rows land at the hard argmin (2.04–2.21°);
cold-start local optimisers (grey) do not recover it from identity. Official checks are text-only: SDPR's tight rows
(θ=0.01, 0.1) return the hard argmin (0.0°), θ=0 is non-tight; the official BPnP recheck is in Table 5.24, where the earlier
P1 same-basis adaptation is withdrawn. (d) Total-degree homotopy: 40/40 complex projective roots on 11/11 instances (max chart residual
7.1e-15; 80 affine roots per projective root); the real/complex split and the number of real minima are instance properties, not constants.
Evidence tag: independent reproduction (this repo) — E15 (pose/ADD-S), E16 (classical), E17 (Theseus), E18 (root count); N1 (LMO,
detector-noise) are controlled estimator experiments with GT-associated correspondences, not detector benchmarks. Official SDPR (cb3aed2)
and BPnP (f1f4f6a) used the released code on CPU; no training, no GPU.

notes.panel_a: ADD-S in mm = metres x 1000; median and percentile bootstrap CI over frames; LMO full n=177 (96 eggbox + 81 glue); the 37-frame subset values are caption-only consistency checks.
notes.panel_b: per-frame mean over 10 noise seeds; median and 95% percentile bootstrap CI over the 15 frames.
notes.panel_c: classical/Theseus rotation medians (deg); Theseus GT/identity rows have no CI in the JSON; cold-start rows are context, not deployable baselines.
notes.panel_c_official: Official SDPR/BPnP are text annotations, not bars: SDPR reports no real-frame degree metric, and the BPnP P1 adaptation is withdrawn. SDPR: on the synthetic 10x10 QPEP instances, tight rows (theta=0.01, 0.1) return the hard argmin (official_xs_vs_hard.rot_deg = 0.0); theta=0 is non-tight (rank 2, xs=None). BPnP: the earlier P1 same-basis adaptation is withdrawn after a recheck (paper Table 5.24); this figure asserts no P1 gradient/cost match. The released backward was executed on all three adapter cases (t_bpnp_backward_ms > 0).
notes.panel_d: n_projective/n_real/n_complex are projective roots; each projective root is an 80-affine-root class; n_minima = real local minima.
